kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Greetings from Paris, where the 2024 Olympics balloon rises again
wire.summary: The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.

wire.title: A new Anthropic model seeks to test how AI could impact the U.S. economy
wire.summary: Will artificial intelligence nibble around the edges of the economy or upend it altogether? A new, interactive model from Anthropic lets people tests their assumptions.

wire.title: Whatever happened to the measles outbreak that shocked a country this year?
wire.summary: Bangladesh has seen over 50,000 confirmed or suspected cases of measles this year. The death toll among children just surpassed 1,000. How are officials trying to bring the outbreak under control?

wire.title: Trump officials propose sweeping changes to the census that would reshape voting maps
wire.summary: A Trump census proposal would stop asking about race and exclude millions of U.S. residents from a count that the 14th Amendment says must include the "whole number of persons in each state."

wire.title: U.S. military destroys 5 Iranian oil tankers. And, the Smithsonian head resigns
wire.summary: The U.S. military says it has destroyed five Iranian oil tankers as the conflict continues to escalate. And, Smithsonian head Lonnie G. Bunch III says he plans to step down by the end of the year.

wire.title: Cargo jet tried to abort unsteady landing before Miami crash, flight data indicates
wire.summary: Flight data suggest an Amazon cargo plane tried to abort an unsteady landing at Miami International Airport before smashing into a van and killing five people inside, according to information investigators released Tuesday.

wire.title: National Guard member arrested in DC, accused of drawing gun on fellow Guard member
wire.summary: A member of the Georgia National Guard deployed in Washington, D.C., as part of a task force to fight crime, has been arrested for pulling a gun on a fellow Guard member in an alleged dispute over regulation haircuts.

wire.title: How to fight with the people we care about, illustrated
wire.summary: Arguing with a partner or a loved one can be anxiety-inducing. Conflict resolution facilitator Priya Parker explains how to start and end a fight — while easing dread for everyone.

wire.title: Mail-in voters weigh flying to vote in person and other backup plans amid uncertainty
wire.summary: Voters and election officials are navigating uncertainty about mail-in voting for the midterms as the legal fight drags on over the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's bid for restrictions.

wire.title: Republicans kick off a 'Trumpapalooza' of a midterm convention Wednesday in Texas
wire.summary: Republicans have never held a midterm convention before. But there's also never been a president like Donald Trump. Billed as a "Trumpapalooza," the unprecedented event kicks of in Dallas Wednesday.

wire.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
wire.summary: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

wire.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
wire.summary: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

wire.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
wire.summary: It is the latest strike in a long trade war, and comes after Canadian counter-tariffs on US goods come into force.

wire.title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
wire.summary: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.

wire.title: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages
wire.summary: Three deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes.

wire.title: N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog
wire.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency's says the facility is cause for "serious concern".
